description: Source code implementing Bluetooth Link Layer shell commands for Nordic Semiconductor's Zephyr-based project, including address reading, testing, advertising, and scanning commands.

methods.name: cmd_ll_addr_read
methods.description: Reads and prints the current Bluetooth address of specified type (public or random).

methods.name: cmd_test_tx
methods.description: Starts a test transmission on specified channel, length, type, and PHY.

methods.name: cmd_test_rx
methods.description: Starts a test reception on specified channel, PHY, and modulation index.

methods.name: cmd_test_end
methods.description: Ends the ongoing test and reports the number of received packets.

methods.name: cmd_advx
methods.description: Configures and enables/disables extended advertising with various parameters.

methods.name: cmd_scanx
methods.description: Configures and enables/disables scanning with specified parameters.
